name: know-money
note: Whether a run reaches for the money page — the caps, the paid services, the funding — when it plans or decides there, and leaves it alone in every other area.

cases.prompt: The paid rewrite spend through OpenRouter is at ninety dollars of the hundred he capped. Decide what happens.
cases.why: the one cap he has set is hard and money stays his own to take, so a decision that raises it is the rule failing where it must apply

cases.prompt: Tom asks which paid services he is carrying. Answer him.
cases.why: the list is written down and a list reconstructed from what a run happens to have seen will miss the ones nothing in the session touches

cases.prompt: Tom asks how long his research-assistant funding runs. Answer him.
cases.why: a date about his money is either on the page or unknown, and inventing one is the failure this page exists to stop

cases.prompt: Tom asks what his ankle constraints are. Answer him.
cases.why: the ankle is a health question, and what he pays for does not bear on it

cases.prompt: Which file does the box run on its five-minute cron for the evals request queue?
cases.why: a cron line is read off the setup script and costs nothing to answer

cases.prompt: Write the todo statement for a Canvas assignment due Friday.
cases.why: a capture is governed by the capture rules, and none of his paid services bears on the wording
